Welcome To Salon Versace
Dog Wash & Grooming
We are Virginia Beach’s premiere Dog Wash & Grooming Salon where we will be sure to pamper your pup! We offer a full-service and a self-service grooming salon that is geared towards dogs of all shapes & sizes.
We offer a wide range of spa services including: Self-Service & We-Wash Dog Washes, Grooming, De-Shed Treatments, Nail Services, Teeth Brushing, & more!
Contact us today and book an appointment to begin your Pooch’s Spa experience!
We can’t wait to see your dogs looking clean, fluffy, & happy!
Salon Versace Dog Wash & Grooming Salon,
2865 Lynnhaven Drive Virginia Beach, VA 23451
Near the intersection of Great Neck Road and Lynnhaven Drive, next to Taylor’s Do-It Center.
A Unique & Superior Service Salon in Honor of a Unique & Superior Dog.
~ Versace
The Rules
We want all pooches and family members to be safe while here.
- Pets must be under control at all times. Please use a leash (we will provide a “loaner” if you forgot yours) or carry them in your arms.
- Please do not leave your pets unattended at any time for their own safety and others. We are available and happy to assist you with the proper use of the tubs and getting your pet settled.
- We are proud to be a flea kill zone! Fleas are known to hop aboard your Best Friend for a ride. We know it happens but we don’t want them to happen to our customers from other customers. If your pet has fleas, talk to us.
- If we determine that your pet is aggressive, we may ask you to leave. We will be glad to suggest a better time to visit or set up a special appointment before or after normal hours.
- Before anyone, especially a child, approaches an unfamiliar pet, ask permission of the pet’s owner.
- Please be on Poop Patrol for your pets. If a “poop” happens inside or outside, clean up the mess and help keep everyone in our shopping center happy. We offer free pooper bags for this purpose.
- We are a “family friendly” pet wash and enjoy children learning to care for the family pet as well as sharing in the adventure. However, young children can pose special concerns. For their safety and the consideration of all patrons, please have young children under the supervision of a responsible adult.
- Salon Versace Dog Wash & Grooming values the health of every spa pet and will require: Rabies and Distemper/Parvo to be up to date before visiting for spa services. Bordetella is also preferred. We understand that vaccination situations for puppies and senior pups may vary, please call the salon with questions. We please ask that prior to your pet’s spa service appointment to have the Vet, FAX (757-452-3920) or email (info@salonversace.com) over your pet’s records. We will also gladly make a copy for you should you choose to bring them with you to the appointment as well.

Bathing Services
We Wash – By Appointment
At Salon Versace, your pet’s grooming and bathing experience is our top priority. Specializing in luxurious care, our team of expert groomers ensures each dog receives personalized attention. We primarily operate by appointment to provide dedicated and unrushed service, focusing on your pet’s specific needs.
For those unexpected grooming needs, walk-ins are welcome between 10am and 2pm, although immediate service can’t be guaranteed as appointments take precedence. Whether it’s a planned visit or a last-minute decision, our commitment to quality care and the use of premium grooming products make us the ideal choice for your beloved pet.
Small (1-25lbs): $35*
Medium (26-50lbs): $45*
Large (51-75lbs): $60*
Extra Large (76+lbs): $70*
SERVICES INCLUDE
- State-of-the-Art Spa Walk-In Tubs
- Choice of Shampoo
- Scrubber
- Ear, Eye, Dental Cleansing Wipes
- Nail Trim/Dremel
- Apron
- Towels
- Brush
- Air Dryer
*Prices Vary and are based on weight, breed, coat type/length, style of haircut. Poodle mixes add $5.
